page_title: BUR 5-0 SHU | Burnley v Sheffield Utd 02/12/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' Chris Kavanagh is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90' The fourth official shows 4 min. of added time.
90' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Burnley comes to nothing.

90' Nathan Redmond (Burnley) latches on to a perfectly taken corner kick deep into the box and attempts to head home. His bullet header heads straight towards the roof of the net, but it's deflected onto the crossbar by the goalkeeper. A wonderful effort. The ball is out of play and Burnley manage to earn a corner.

89' Johann Berg Gudmundsson (Burnley) collects a brilliant pass inside the box and finds himself in a goal scoring opportunity. He takes a shot, but the effort is well blocked by one of the defending players. Burnley win a corner.

87' He should have scored! William Osula (Sheffield Utd) latches onto a pull back in the box right in front of goal, but his shot towards the middle of the goal is pretty weak and James Trafford makes an easy save.

87' Vitinho (Burnley) get himself out of a tight corner inside the box then shoots. The keeper leaps for the ball but it flies just wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Sheffield Utd will have a goal kick.
85' Jack Robinson (Sheffield Utd) appears to handle the ball in the box, but the referee wasn't in the best position. Let's see what he decides.
83' A substitution has been made. Dara O'Shea goes off and Hjalmar Ekdal (Burnley) comes on.

80' 5 - 0 The ball rebounds and arrives at the feet of Josh Brownhill (Burnley) just outside the box. He doesn't think twice and fires a brilliant shot inside the right post. His attempt was beyond the reach of Wesley Foderingham, so the score changes to 5:0.

78' That was close by Michael Obafemi (Burnley)! He receives a pass on the edge of the box and shoots, but the ball goes inches wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Sheffield Utd.
77' Luca Koleosho (Burnley) comes off the pitch to be replaced by Mike Tresor Ndayishimiye.
77' Vincent Kompany prepares a substitution. Zeki Amdouni is replaced by Nathan Redmond (Burnley).
77' Substitution. Michael Obafemi (Burnley) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Jay Rodriguez walks off.
75' 4 - 0 Zeki Amdouni passes the ball into the penalty area. Luca Koleosho (Burnley) collects it and quickly sends it into the bottom left corner via the post! The goalkeeper was helpless. 4:0!
74' What a chance that is! Luca Koleosho (Burnley) wastes a huge opportunity as he receives a beautiful pass inside the box but is somehow only able to prod the ball onto the left post!

73' 3 - 0 An amazing individual effort from Zeki Amdouni (Burnley) ends with a strike from inside the penalty area. He sends the ball precisely into the bottom right corner and makes it 3:0. Wesley Foderingham was helpless.
72' Whoa! Such gestures are commonly penalised and Gustavo Hamer (Sheffield Utd) duly receives a yellow card.
72' Anel Ahmedhodzic (Sheffield Utd) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Chris Kavanagh had an easy-decision to make.

69' William Osula (Sheffield Utd) had a good opportunity when he latched on to a cross from the wing, but his header wasn't accurate at all and the ball went well over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Burnley will have a goal kick.
69' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Sheffield Utd.

69' William Osula (Sheffield Utd) latches on to a precise pass and finds himself one-on-one with the keeper, but his effort is straight at James Trafford, who is alert and makes an easy save to deny him. The referee blows his whistle, Sheffield Utd are awarded a corner kick.
67' Jordan Beyer (Burnley) is awarded a yellow card for his behaviour.
65' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Jacob Bruun Larsen trots off the pitch and is replaced by Johann Berg Gudmundsson (Burnley).
64' Chris Kavanagh shows a yellow card to William Osula (Sheffield Utd) for his blatant foul.
64' Jacob Bruun Larsen (Burnley) plays a lovely through ball to Zeki Amdouni, but he can't beat Wesley Foderingham and loses the ball.
64' A great run by Vitinho (Burnley) gets him into the box, but his powerful shot is bravely blocked by a defender.
63' Burnley hold the ball and display nice passing from player to player.
60' Luca Koleosho (Burnley) finds himself behind the opposition's defence, but the game is stopped for offside.
57' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Sheffield Utd, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
54' Burnley players are exchanging short passes with one another, waiting for the right moment to beat the opposition's defence.
49' Vitinho (Burnley) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety.
46' Half-time substitution. John Fleck (Sheffield Utd) is replaced by William Osula.
46' Half-time substitution. Luke Thomas (Sheffield Utd) will not participate anymore and James McAtee is coming on.
46' Here is a change after the half-time break. Cameron Archer (Sheffield Utd) is replaced by Benie Traore.
46' The second half gets underway.
45+6' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45+6' Burnley take a short corner kick.

45+6' Charlie Taylor (Burnley) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger. Burnley force a corner. They send men into the box.
45+4' The resulting set piece from Burnley is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
45+3' Jay Rodriguez (Burnley) tries to send a pass but it's blocked. Burnley will take a corner kick.

45+1' Chris Kavanagh blows his whistle and Oliver McBurnie (Sheffield Utd) is shown a second yellow card for his foul. His manager will not be pleased. He has lot of time to think about it as he walks off.
45' Jacob Bruun Larsen (Burnley) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
45' We will have 5 min. of added time.
45' The free kick is taken short by Sheffield Utd.

45' It looks like Sander Berge (Burnley) saw red with that tackle. Chris Kavanagh won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul. Sheffield Utd will take a free kick near the side line.
43' Luke Thomas (Sheffield Utd) has to be very careful for the rest of the match after receiving a yellow card from the referee for a bad tackle on an opponent.
41' Burnley have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
41' Jacob Bruun Larsen (Burnley) gets to the rebound just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by one of the defending players. Burnley have been awarded a corner kick.
40' Vitinho (Burnley) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
38' Dara O'Shea (Burnley) has tested the patience of referee Chris Kavanagh and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
38' The free kick from long range, taken by Burnley, is overhit and the ball goes out of play.
37' The referee had an easy-decision to make. A yellow card is given to Oliver McBurnie (Sheffield Utd) for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
34' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by John Fleck (Sheffield Utd) was quite harsh and Chris Kavanagh didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.

32' Cameron Archer (Sheffield Utd) finds space inside the box to shoot after collecting a short pass, but it's a wasted effort as it flies high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Burnley.
32' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Auston Trusty (Sheffield Utd).
29' 2 - 0 Jacob Bruun Larsen (Burnley) finds himself one-on-one with the keeper after a great pass by Dara O'Shea. He takes the shot early and scores!
27' Jack Robinson (Sheffield Utd) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat.
27' Sheffield Utd restart play with a quick free kick.
27' Jordan Beyer (Burnley) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Chris Kavanagh blows his whistle for a foul. Sheffield Utd are awarded a free kick. Let's see what they create from this.
25' Vitinho (Burnley) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence.
25' Paul Heckingbottom is forced to make an unplanned substitution as George Baldock suffers an injury and Jayden Bogle (Sheffield Utd) comes on.
23' The game is interrupted now, George Baldock (Sheffield Utd) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
22' A clumsy foul by Anel Ahmedhodzic (Sheffield Utd) and Chris Kavanagh blows his whistle. A free kick to Burnley.
21' The Burnley players are exchanging short passes in an attempt to create a shooting opportunity.
21' Gustavo Hamer (Sheffield Utd) was too forceful with his tackle and Chris Kavanagh interrupted the game to signal a free kick.

20' Oliver Norwood (Sheffield Utd) collects a rebound a long way out and doesn't hesitate to release a goal-bound hammer of a shot. His attempt is precise and towards the left post. It would have probably ended in the back of the net if it wasn't for James Trafford and his brilliant save.
17' Vitinho (Burnley) sprays a pass out to Jay Rodriguez, but he can't beat his man inside the box.

14' Gustavo Hamer (Sheffield Utd) makes a yard for himself and goes for goal from long range. It never troubles the goalkeeper as it flies well wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Burnley will have a goal kick.
11' Jay Rodriguez (Burnley) gets the ball and drives a shot high over the bar from the edge of the area. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Sheffield Utd.
9' Burnley failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
8' Vitinho (Burnley) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared. The ball is out of play. Burnley will have a chance to score from a corner.

5' Sheffield Utd hold possession of the ball and display neat passing from player to player. They are waiting for the right moment to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.

1' 1 - 0 It's a goal! Jay Rodriguez (Burnley) bursts into the box to get on the end of a whipped in cross from Charlie Taylor and scores magnificently from close range into the bottom right corner. 1:0.
1' The first half has just begun.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Burnley will have the kick-off.
Chris Kavanagh is the one to supervise the game today.
